channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: Death of 15 elephants in Kenyan national park sparks outrage, investigation
item.dc:creator: Rael Ombuor
item.description: The unexplained deaths over the past month have raised fears of poisoning.

item.title: Trump threatens to hit Iran ‘hard’ following missile attack on U.S. assets
item.dc:creator: Tara Copp, Alex Horton, Ellen Francis, Susannah George
item.description: The threat came after Saudi Arabia joined U.S. military strikes on Iranian proxies.

item.title: Powerful earthquake strikes southern Japan; dozens reported missing
item.dc:creator: Ben Noll, Joshua Yang
item.description: There are reports of at least one fatality after the 7.1-magnitude quake on the island of Kyushu. Nearly 50,000 homes were left without power.

item.title: In China, a sober-curious generation challenges a business culture of heavy drinking
item.dc:creator: Lyric Li
item.description: Alcohol has been a fixture of professional and social life in China for decades, but a new generation is resisting pressure to drink excessively — or at all.

item.title: Russia closes window for dissent as Ukraine’s attacks stir public dismay
item.dc:creator: Catherine Belton
item.description: Moscow is coming under increasing pressure over Kyiv’s relentless drone strikes. Ukraine’s president is due to meet in Washington with President Donald Trump on Tuesday.
